page.title: BD Restore
page.subtitle: Migrate a database to the system's standard format — imports tables and generates the SQL script ready to load.

excel.label: Excel Spreadsheet
excel.desc: Import products, customers, and settings directly from pre-formatted Excel spreadsheets. Ideal for databases that don't use Firebird.

sql.label: BDsia SQL
sql.desc: Loads bdsia.sql, performs a structural comparison with the imported PAF base, and generates a merged database ready to load.
